headline: Exchange Inflow Jumps To 710.7 Million Dollars From 450.0 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in exchange reserves was a 710.7 million dollar inflow, versus a 450.0 million dollar inflow on the prior print, which means coins are arriving on exchanges where holders can sell. That inflow is 0.259 percent of the 274.6 billion dollars held across 79 venues, which means coins are reaching exchanges at a heavy pace. Bitcoin stood at 83k, up 2.62 percent, while buy-side cumulative volume delta printed 306.4 bitcoin, which means buyers are lifting price as coins arrive on exchanges.
author: jordan
